verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product that collects telemetry, so a telemetry opt-out is a category error for this kind of product. Its data-protection practice advises clients on GDPR compliance, which is a legal service and not a user-facing tracking control. No evidence shows the firm ships software with telemetry settings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
